reviews.author: Marc Sanchez Margalef
reviews.text:
I went to Judit's office with quite a bit of neck pain, and honestly, the experience was very positive. From the very first moment, she exuded confidence and professionalism, taking the time to listen and explain everything clearly.
The treatment was very effective; I noticed improvement immediately, and over the following days, the pain decreased significantly. Furthermore, she is friendly and approachable, making you feel comfortable throughout the entire appointment.
Without a doubt, I recommend her to anyone looking for good chiropractic care. I'll definitely be back!

reviews.author: gaston manero
reviews.text:

Excellent service. Without a doubt, I'll be back!

reviews.author: Jennifer
reviews.text:
Treatments with Judith are a truly wonderful experience! She personalizes each one and adapts it to your needs with honesty and genuine care.
It's a blend of professionalism and compassion that makes you feel you're in good hands.
My experience with the laser treatment has been the best after years of trying different places. I also use products like the aloe vera gel, the cream deodorant, and the yogurt scrub, which are fantastic and very reasonably priced. I haven't had the chance to try the massages yet, but I gave one as a gift, and the recipient said they felt like they were floating! 😍 By the way, the gift cards are adorable! Whenever I have the opportunity, I recommend the treatments at Judith Quiromasaje y Estética Avanzada.
Since I met her, I don't go to anyone else. Thank you for always being so helpful, Judith.

reviews.author: Katty Urriola
reviews.text: Excellent massage therapist. I had a terrible muscle knot in my neck and back. She helped me get rid of it. Excellent hands, I'll definitely be back.

reviews.author: Natalia Sanmamed
reviews.text: Excellent service! I had a deep tissue massage and from the very first minute, Judit put all her energy into helping her feel better. 100% recommended! Delighted to have found you.
